svg.title: Mind Map Studio: rich nodes with roles, colour, markers, tasks, tags, pictures, notes and labelled links
svg.desc: A looping animation in four scenes with the details panel open on the right (Ctrl+I). 1: the node Sign-up target gets the role theme, a teal colour bar and a 🎯 marker. 2: Ctrl+Enter ticks two child tasks of Go-live checklist and its progress goes from 1/3 to 2/3 to 3/3. 3: typing #p1 #backend while renaming adds two tags, and the Tags filter dims the nodes without #backend. 4: Ctrl+V pastes a picture onto the node Hero image, Shift+Space opens it full size, Markdown notes are written in the panel, and a dashed cross-link labelled depends on is drawn from Go-live to Hero image.

g.text: Scroll or pinch to zoom, drag to move, 0 fits the picture.
A parent counts its done tasks.
End a title with #tag while renaming,
Ctrl+I opens the details panel: give a node a role, a colour, an emoji.
Ctrl+Enter ticks a task; its parent counts what is done.
End a title with #p1 #backend. The Tags filter dims everything else.
Paste a picture, open it with Shift+Space, add notes, name a link.
